name: Media Manager
tagline: Plan, create, and publish across all your social platforms
shortDescription: A comprehensive social media planning and publishing platform that helps teams collaborate, schedule content, and measure performance across multiple channels.
longDescription: Media Manager is a professional-grade social media management platform designed for modern marketing teams. Plan campaigns with visual calendars, create platform-optimized content with our intelligent composer, schedule posts across all major social networks, organize assets in a centralized vault, and track performance with detailed analytics. Built for collaboration, Media Manager integrates seamlessly with your workflow through MCP agent access and TaskJoe integration.

features.title: Products & Plans
features.description: Organize your social strategy with products and campaigns that map to your business goals

features.title: Smart Composer
features.description: Create once, optimize for each platform automatically with per-platform variants

features.title: Scheduling & Publishing
features.description: Visual calendar interface with intelligent scheduling and multi-platform publishing

features.title: Media Vault
